```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library("tibble")
library("glue")
library("papaja")
type_levels <- c(
  "Study design",
  "Inclusion/exclusion criteria",
  "Research question(s)",
  "Hypotheses",
  "Sample size",
  "Data preparation",
  "Variable operationalization or computation",
  "Analytic approach",
  "Covariates",
  "Inferential criteria"
)

reason_levels <- c(
  "Typo/oversight",
  "Data-collection or documentation error",
  "Preregistered plan not possible or inappropriate because of data",
  "Researchers gained new knowledge",
  "Suggested by reviewer/editor",
  "Miscommunication among author team"
)

timing_levels <- c(
  "Before data collection",
  "During data collection",
  "After data access",
  "After results known"
)

```

```{r deviations-table}
# Jede Zeile = eine Abweichung. Details-Spalte: Type / Reason / Timing,
# getrennt durch \\newline (Werte stammen aus den *_levels oben).
dev_table <- tribble(
  ~`No.`, ~`Details`, ~`Original Wording`, ~`Description`, ~`Reader Impact`,
  "1",
  glue("Type: {type_levels[3]} \\newline Reason: {reason_levels[1]} \\newline Timing: {timing_levels[3]}"),
  "Provide the wording from the original preregistration, or a description of what the original preregistration plan was.",
  "Provide a narrative description and justification for the deviation.",
  "Provide a narrative description of whether and how the deviation should affect the readers’ interpretation of the study and/or results.",
  "2",
  glue("Type: {type_levels[1]} \\newline Reason: {reason_levels[1]} \\newline Timing: {timing_levels[1]}"),
  "", "", "",
  "3",
  glue("Type: {type_levels[1]} \\newline Reason: {reason_levels[1]} \\newline Timing: {timing_levels[1]}"),
  "", "", ""
)
```

```{r unregistered-table}
unreg_table <- tribble(
  ~`No.`, ~`Details`, ~`Original Wording`, ~`Description`, ~`Reader Impact`,
  "1",
  glue("Type: {type_levels[6]} \\newline Timing: {timing_levels[3]}"),
  "If applicable, provide the wording from the original preregistration that was unregistered or not specific enough. If the issue was not addressed in the preregistration at all, please note that here as well.",
  "Provide a narrative description of how the unregistered step was handled, and a justification for that approach.",
  "Provide a narrative description of whether and how the unregistered step should affect the readers’ interpretation of the study and/or results.",
  "2",
  glue("Type: {type_levels[1]} \\newline Timing: {timing_levels[1]}"),
  "", "", "",
  "3",
  glue("Type: {type_levels[1]} \\newline Timing: {timing_levels[1]}"),
  "", "", ""
)
```

```{r render-tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Breite der drei Textspalten
breite <- "5.0cm"

# Macht aus einem tribble die LaTeX-Zeilen für die Tabelle.
# Pro Eintrag gibt es eine Zeile je Detail (Type, Reason, Timing),
# Nummer und Texte gehen über alle diese Zeilen.
tabellenzeilen <- function(tbl) {
  zeilen <- c()

  for (r in 1:nrow(tbl)) {
    nr      <- tbl[[1]][r]
    details <- strsplit(as.character(tbl[[2]][r]), "\\newline", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    details <- trimws(details)
    texte   <- as.character(c(tbl[[3]][r], tbl[[4]][r], tbl[[5]][r]))
    n       <- length(details)

    # je länger der Text, desto höher muss die Zeile sein
    hoehe   <- max(1.5, max(nchar(texte)) / 27 / n + 0.3)
    stuetze <- sprintf("\\rule[-%.2f\\baselineskip]{0pt}{%.2f\\baselineskip}", hoehe / 2, hoehe)

    for (i in 1:n) {
      label <- sub(":.*", "", details[i])
      wert  <- trimws(sub("^[^:]*:", "", details[i]))
      wert  <- gsub("/", "/\\\\allowbreak ", wert)  # Umbruch nach "/" erlauben

      if (i == 1) {
        nummer  <- sprintf("\\multirow[t]{%d}{*}{%s}", n, nr)
        spalten <- ifelse(nchar(texte) > 0,
                          sprintf("\\multirow[t]{%d}{%s}{\\raggedright\\itshape %s}", n, breite, texte),
                          "")
      } else {
        nummer  <- ""
        spalten <- c("", "", "")
      }

      zeile <- paste(c(nummer, paste0(label, stuetze), wert, spalten), collapse = " & ")
      linie <- if (i < n) "\\cline{2-3}" else "\\hline"
      zeilen <- c(zeilen, paste0(zeile, " \\\\", linie))
    }
  }

  zeilen
}

# Titel und Spaltenüberschriften
kopf <- function(titel, beschreibung) {
  c("\\specialrule{1.2pt}{0pt}{0pt}",
    paste0("\\multicolumn{6}{l}{\\textbf{", titel, "}} \\\\"),
    "\\hline",
    paste0("\\multicolumn{1}{c|}{\\#} & \\multicolumn{2}{c|}{Details} & ",
           "\\multicolumn{1}{c|}{Original Wording} & ",
           "\\multicolumn{1}{c|}{", beschreibung, "} & ",
           "\\multicolumn{1}{c}{Reader Impact} \\\\"),
    "\\hline")
}

# Spaltenformat: Nummer, Label, Wert, 3 Textspalten
sp <- function(b) paste0(">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{", b, "}")
spaltenformat <- paste("c", sp("1.5cm"), sp("3.6cm"), sp(breite), sp(breite), sp(breite), sep = "|")

note <- paste("\\textit{Note.} Choose one characteristic for each dropdown menu.",
              "If more than one type or reason apply to the same deviation, then replace the dropdown menu with details.",
              "Provide one deviation per row, and add or delete rows as needed.")

cat(
  "\\begin{landscape}\\begin{table}[!htbp]",
  "\\caption{Summary of preregistration deviations and unregistered steps.}",
  "{\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.1}\\renewcommand{\\baselinestretch}{1}\\scriptsize",
  paste0("\\begin{tabular}{", spaltenformat, "}"),
  kopf("Deviations", "Deviation Description"),
  tabellenzeilen(dev_table),
  kopf("Unregistered Steps", "Unregistered Step Description"),
  tabellenzeilen(unreg_table),
  "\\specialrule{1.2pt}{0pt}{0pt}",
  "\\end{tabular}}",
  "\\par\\vspace{4pt}",
  paste0("{\\renewcommand{\\baselinestretch}{1}\\footnotesize\\noindent ", note, "\\par}"),
  "\\end{table}\\end{landscape}",
  sep = "\n"
)
```
